# GroupDocs.Comparison for Python via .NET

> GroupDocs.Comparison for Python via .NET is a document comparison API that programmatically compares 50+ document formats (Word, PDF, Excel, PowerPoint and more), detects changes, and produces a result document with highlighted differences.

This repository contains runnable Python examples for the on-premise GroupDocs.Comparison for Python via .NET SDK (PyPI package `groupdocs-comparison-net`). The package bundles the .NET runtime and works through it. This is the local SDK — not the separate GroupDocs.Comparison Cloud REST API.

This repo also ships a detailed `AGENTS.md` (the same reference bundled inside the wheel) with canonical imports, the full API surface, licensing, and troubleshooting — read it first when working with the API.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://docs.groupdocs.com/comparison/python-net/): developer guide for GroupDocs.Comparison for Python via .NET
- [LLM-optimized docs](https://docs.groupdocs.com/comparison/python-net/llms-full.txt): full documentation as a single machine-readable file
- [API Reference](https://reference.groupdocs.com/comparison/python-net/): full class and method reference
- [Supported Document Formats](https://docs.groupdocs.com/comparison/python-net/supported-document-formats/): all formats the API can compare

## Examples

- [Examples folder](https://github.com/groupdocs-comparison/GroupDocs.Comparison-for-Python-via-.NET/tree/master/Examples): quick_start, basic_usage, advanced_usage, and developer-guide Python examples
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/groupdocs-comparison/GroupDocs.Comparison-for-Python-via-.NET/blob/master/AGENTS.md): AI-agent reference bundled inside the wheel — imports, quick start, API surface, troubleshooting
- [AI agents and LLM integration](https://docs.groupdocs.com/comparison/python-net/agents-and-llm-integration/): using the API from Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI assistants
- [How-to articles (blog)](https://blog.groupdocs.com/categories/groupdocs.comparison-product-family/): task-oriented tutorials for comparing Word, PDF, Excel, PowerPoint and other documents across platforms

- [PyPI Package](https://pypi.org/project/groupdocs-comparison-net/): install with `pip install groupdocs-comparison-net`
